title: Regularity of compact convex sets--classical and noncommutative
summary: The classical theory of regularity of embeddings of compact convex sets was developed in the 1970s, exclusively in the real case, and even there it does not appear to have been stated in its simplest form. We begin by revisiting this setting, showing that under a reasonable condition, every locally convex topological vector space E that contains and is spanned by a compact convex set lying in a hyperplane not passing through the origin, is a (specific) dual Banach space equipped with the weak* topology.
